lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible vertical columns of high-intensity circular spots; the primary central column exhibits 5 distinct, roughly equidistant nodes between the dorsal ridge and the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular spots, creating a localized grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal ridge is observed along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side to lower-luminance shadow pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple smaller, high-contrast silhouettes consistent with remoras positioned near the pectoral fin and ventral region.
